text: 据新华社，习近平同英国首相伯纳姆通电话。 李强：统筹推进住房、小区、社区到城区的更新改造，加快老旧街区厂区转型升级。 布油逼近100大关！胡塞武装深入内陆，打击沙特能源设施。 据共同社，日本央行计划在9月的会议上将利率上调至1.25%。 霍尔木兹危机意外“救活”苏伊士运河：7月收入暴增42%创两年半新高。 据彭博，津巴布韦暂停锑和钨出口。 控制委石油还不够？报道：美国又将目光投向黄金等矿产资源。 英国以至少1998年以来最高的融资成本发行国债，但需求依然稳健。 苹果罕见签3-5年NAND长约、或不设价格上限，AI挤占产能令存储议价权易主。 一周接连三项试
text_en: According to Xinhua, Xi Jinping spoke by phone with UK Prime Minister Burnham. Li Qiang: Coordinate and advance renewal and renovation from housing, neighborhoods, and communities to urban districts, accelerating transformation and upgrading of old blocks and industrial zones. Brent crude nears $100! Houthis strike deep inland, targeting Saudi energy facilities. According to Kyodo News, the Bank of Japan plans to raise interest rates to 1.25% at its September meeting. The Hormuz crisis unexpectedly 'revived' the Suez Canal: July revenue surged 42% to a two-and-a-half-year high. According to Bloomberg, Zimbabwe suspended antimony and tungsten exports. Not enough to control OPEC oil? Reports: U.S. sets sights on gold and other mineral resources. UK issued government bonds at the highest financing costs since at least 1998, yet demand remained solid. Apple rarely signs 3-5 year NAND long-term agreements, possibly without price caps; AI squeezing capacity shifts storage pricing power. Three consecutive tests in one week.
